findings.title: Local Qwen runs are single empty completions: 0 tool calls and no model text in all 58 local logs
findings.check: L1-08 / OS-1 (H14 refuted; explains H4 and the local 0% rates)
findings.evidence: Raw read of the 672 pinned blobs through agentprov.ingest: of 58 local logs (pipeline local 56, Local model 2), 2 have no messages, 2 (Local model) end after the user message (system, user; no outcome, incomplete), and 54 are exactly [system, user, assistant] where the assistant content is one text block with empty text and tool_calls []. Local assistant turns 54, with calls 0, with call-like text 0 (<function=, <tool_call>, ```json); tool messages 0. Hence local utility 0/54 (pre-pass 0/14, qwen2 benign 0/13, attacked 0/27) and ASR 0/27; the payload reaches no local agent (0/27). gpt-4o logs: 614/614 final assistant text non-empty. The AER keeps the empty text as unk /parts/0/text ambiguous (14/14 sampled local turns, agentdojo.empty_assistant_text_ambiguous_unverified); the L2 degenerate counter is 0 and no issue code names the empty run. Not a parse drop (artefacts.toml agentdojo.art.local_parse_drop needs tags); no artefacts.toml entry covers this source. Matches the open LocalLLM empty-answer issues (#219, #220) and the fork's local provider changes (port default 11434, forced name 'Local model'); the serving cause is not determinable from the logs. Verifier: at the pin local_llm.chat_completion_request turns any exception into an empty response and _parse_model_output never drops text, so a failed request yields exactly this shape; the 2 'Local model' logs are incomplete_run (separate entry).
findings.reproduction: PRECHECK_REPO=$PWD uv run python docs/reports/precheck/data/shreeyavarma-llm-safety/exam-scripts/raw_checks.py docs/reports/precheck/data/shreeyavarma-llm-safety/exam-scripts  -> "local": {"logs": 56, "asst_turns": 54, "asst_no_calls": 54, "callish_no_calls": 0, "logs_empty_final": 54, "logs_zero_calls": 56, "tool_msgs": 0};  PRECHECK_REPO=$PWD uv run python docs/reports/precheck/data/shreeyavarma-llm-safety/exam-scripts/raw_checks2.py docs/reports/precheck/data/shreeyavarma-llm-safety/exam-scripts  -> "('local', 'empty', False)": 54; local_shapes (system,user,assistant) 13 + 41, (system,user) 1 + 1, () 1 + 1; local_final_content "('list:1', '[]')": 54; gpt_final {"text": 614}
findings.recommendation: Keep every local log (user rule: never exclude for zero successes or for being a fragment). Disclose in the corpus datasheet and manuscript that the local arms (58 logs) record a harness/serving failure, not Qwen behaviour: their 0% utility and ASR must not be read as robustness. Family owner: add the proposed artefacts.toml entry (route via orchestrator) and consider an issue code for runs whose only model turn is empty (so the index can filter them); check the same shape in agentdojo-upstream local dirs and ast-survey-agentdojo (the cross-corpus trajectory match is a qwen run with the same shape). The prereg class (local_parse_drop extension) does not fit: no tags exist.

  { snapshot = "shreeyavarma-llm-safety:head", count = 54, basis = "pre-check raw read 2026-10-15: local logs whose only assistant turn is one empty text block without tool calls", status = "proposed" },
  { snapshot = "shreeyavarma-llm-safety:head", count = 58, basis = "pre-check raw read 2026-10-15: local logs with 0 tool calls (54 + 2 empty-message + 2 Local model; the 2 Local model logs belong to agentdojo.art.incomplete_run; descriptive count)", unit = "logs", status = "proposed" },
]

verdicts.reasoning: Raw re-read through rawload/agentprov.ingest: all 54 local assistant blocks have keys {content,type}, type text, total string length 0; tool_calls empty in all. Population split 54 [s,u,a] / 2 [s,u] / 2 empty reproduced; utility 0/54, ASR 0/27, 0 tool messages. At the pin, local_llm.chat_completion_request swallows any exception into an empty response and _parse_model_output keeps completion.strip(), so the shape is what a failed request produces (supports #220); an empty generation stays possible. No artefacts.toml entry covers it (local_parse_drop needs tags, silent_rerun needs null content). R1 source-defect; S2 because it fixes local utility and ASR at 0. Corrections: Detector must cite agentdojo.empty_assistant_text_ambiguous_unverified@1 (verified_code [], D-24) or a dedicated I rule. The 2 Local model [system,user] logs belong to agentdojo.art.incomplete_run; the 58 count is descriptive only. The 27 unattacked local security True values are the benign constant.

findings.title: Prereg H4 trajectory clause wrong: 27 local attacked runs are trajectory-identical to qwen2 benign runs
findings.check: L1-04 (H4 refuted on the trajectory clause)
findings.evidence: l1-head.json L1-04 trajectory_identical: 2 groups, 29 units of 670 with a fingerprint (643 distinct); group 1 = qwen2 benign user_task_0 + 14 qwen_agent tool_knowledge user_task_0 (IT0..13), group 2 = qwen2 benign user_task_1 + 13 qwen_agent tool_knowledge user_task_1 (IT13 is the empty log); facets differing attack_dir, results_dir, file. Cause: PC-01 (one empty completion before any tool call, so the injected environment is never read; 0/27 payload reach). 0 byte-identical pairs within the part and 0 cross-corpus byte overlap (H4 byte clauses hold). Cross-corpus trajectory matches (_cross/l1-xdup.json): 3 units, the two Local model system+user-only logs with yockcheng-prompt-injection-harness (claude-3-haiku / claude-3-7-sonnet incomplete logs) and one local qwen_agent pre-pass with ast-survey-agentdojo runs_qwen3_14b: degenerate shapes, not shared data. CC-01 does not change these counts (no calls). 28 local attacked files; 1 (empty messages) has no fingerprint, so 27 fingerprinted units form 2 trajectories.

findings.title: Our profile note and census counter misdescribe the two empty-message logs
findings.evidence: (a) Profile quirk agentdojo.empty_messages_without_outcome note says both empty logs are in my_runs_qwen2_agent_no_attack; L1 zero_messages flags them at my_runs_qwen2_agent_no_attack/local/workspace/user_task_14/none/none.json and my_runs_qwen_agent/local/workspace/user_task_1/tool_knowledge/injection_task_13.json (one in each dir). (b) The phase-10d census counter agentdojo.empty_messages_with_outcome = 2 counts unit outcome_only rows (tools/agentdojo/import_scan.py l. 331) although neither log carries an outcome (both utility/security absent); the same 2 logs are the census empty_messages_without_outcome 2. R4. The same definition is in the product census src/agentprov/adapters/agentdojo/census.py l. 125.

findings.recommendation: Family owner: correct the profile note (one log in each of my_runs_qwen2_agent_no_attack and my_runs_qwen_agent; a note change still bumps the profile bytes, AD-18, so batch it with the round); census tool owner: count empty_messages_with_outcome only for outcome_only units with a judgement. Also fix census.py:125 to require a judgement; check agentdojo-upstream's declared 207 under the new definition.

verdicts.reasoning: os1.py flags exactly 2 zero_messages units, one per directory as stated; the profile note (l. 184) puts both in qwen2. tools/agentdojo/import_scan.py l. 331 and the product census src/agentprov/adapters/agentdojo/census.py l. 125 count every outcome_only unit as with_outcome without a judgement check, while without_outcome checks it; mapper.py l. 1564 detects with_outcome only with judgements. Corrections: (b) is also in census.py:125 (the source of the 'measured' value); fix it to require a judgement and mirror in import_scan.py:331; check agentdojo-upstream's declared 207. (b) is better labelled a census-counter defect with no byte effect.
